Class Exchange.Builder

java.lang.Object
ntnu.gruppe21.model.Exchange.Builder
Enclosing class:
Exchange
public static class Exchange.Builder extends Object
Standard builder following the standard builder creational pattern. Name and TransactionFactory does not have a default value, everything else does but can be subject to change when building.
